blocks.py:
@lru_cache(maxsize=None)
def go(pos, tight, lead_zero, last_digit):
    if pos == len(digits): return 1
    limit = digits[pos] if tight else 9
    total = 0
    for d in range(limit + 1):
        if last_digit == d == something_invalid: continue
        total += go(pos+1, tight and d == limit,
                    lead_zero and d == 0, d)
    return total
# call: go(R_digits...) - go(L_minus_1...)
